content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm experiencing an issue with a 230 RC device. After a possible grid fluctuation over the weekend, the 230 RC is unable to execute the installed program, which now appears deleted or cleared from the interface. Any guidance would be appreciated. Thank you, [user_name].

Which model are you working with? Does your device have a screen and navigational buttons, or is it the version without a display? If it has a screen, someone may have used the buttons to delete the program. Try reloading your program and consider setting a password for added protection.

Hi, There are generally two reasons for a missing program: 1. Someone used the device keys to clear the program; for some models like [product_name] [article_no], this can be done even without the password. 2. There may have been a memory or memory card failure, which is rare but can cause program loss. Unfortunately, in either situation, the program can't be recovered from the device. Could you share the part number and describe what is shown on the display, such as 'No Program'? Best regards, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users indicate that a program installed on a [product_name] device was lost, most likely due to accidental deletion using device controls or a rare memory issue. Key user concerns are the inability to recover deleted or lost protected programs, causing work disruption. No error message appears in the system regarding this loss. It is advised to protect devices with a password, but even so, recovery of deleted software is not feasible.
analysis.user_expectations: Users wish to have a way to restore or retrieve deleted software programs from their [product_name] device, particularly when protected with a password. They also expect tools for diagnosing the causes behind program loss.
